title: SBC Medical Group discloses data breach affecting millions
excerpt: A filing with the SEC reveals that two cybersecurity incidents exposed the personal data of 1.6 million SBC Medical Group customers and employees.
body_html:
SBC Medical Group has disclosed that two separate cybersecurity incidents led to the exposure of sensitive information belonging to both customers and employees. According to a filing submitted to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the stolen data includes personal details affecting approximately 1.6 million individuals.

The company issued warnings regarding the incidents, detailing that unauthorized parties gained access to the information. Investigations into the security breaches are ongoing to determine the full scope of the compromised data and the methods used by the attackers.
